biotools.summary: Utility functions for working with CONCH data, listing remote files. One function assigns HoverNet nuclei to ProvGigaPath tiles with a scale factor to align coordinates. Provides internal utility functions for 'imageFeatureTCGA' and most functions are not meant for end users.
